observations.finding: Treated fields are markedly less confluent than DMSO f_ad322e23a39f. DMSO shows large continuous epithelial sheet with 100+ cells; treated f_14a98e1928db and f_8755f81f87e3 show small fragmented clusters and isolated cells on black background, consistent with growth inhibition / cell loss.

Marked increase in rounded, bright mitotic-like cells: intensely blue-white condensed DNA (DAPI) with very bright green (beta-tubulin) halo. e.g. 5-8 per field vs 1-2 rare bright mitotics in DMSO. Estimated 10-20% of cells, often singly or pairs.
Interphase nuclei (blue) on average smaller than DMSO. DMSO: regular oval ~35-40px major axis; treated: compact nuclei ~30px, area ~60% of DMSO.
Nuclear shape more irregular / less round: increased lobing, elongation and concave borders vs smooth oval nuclei in DMSO.

F-actin (red) brighter and more heterogeneous at cortex / periphery in treated clusters: punctate high-contrast rim and foci vs diffuse uniform cortical/red cytoplasmic staining in DMSO. Interphase cells show spiky contracted outlines.

Beta-tubulin (green) interphase network still filamentous but less spread; mitotic cells show intensely bright spindle-like green signal. No diffuse loss or overt bundling resolvable in composite without grayscale channels.

Reflection post-unblinding:

Specimen s_2cdd0232ac = PP-2 (PubChem CID 4878, 1-tert-butyl-3-(4-chlorophenyl)pyrazolo[3,4-d]pyrimidin-4-amine; ChEMBL CHEMBL406845, no curated mechanism per lookup) – widely used Src-family kinase inhibitor, annotated in BBBC021 as 'Epithelial'. My call Protein synthesis (p=0.74) was incorrect.

Why I was misled: 
- All dose wells showed monotonic nuclear shrinkage (nuc_area rho -1.0, z -15.9 at 30µM, e10), irregularity (nuc_form_factor z -33.6, e3) and strong actin texture (act_glcm_contrast z 28 at 30µM, rho +1.0, e11) with only late, high-dose mitotic-like rise (frac_mitotic z 11.3 at 30µM vs 0.08 at 3µM, e9). This profile cosine-matched protein-synthesis references (cycloheximide, emetine, anisomycin) at 0.90 similarity (e7, e15) and persisted at the cleaner 3µM well (7/10 protein synthesis neighbors, e17). 
- Microscopist favored microtubule destabilizer/Eg5 (e6) due to rounded mitotic-like cells, which I discounted because tubulin polymer did not decrease (tub_mean rho +1.0, e13) and mitotic rise was not dose-progressive.
- True epithelial/Src-inhibitor phenotype (cortical actin remodeling, contracted irregular nuclei, reduced spread area, cell_solidity changes) overlaps morphologically with translation-inhibition stress – both produce smaller cells, actin heterogeneity and growth inhibition – so atlas similarity was not specific. Epithelial class has few distinctive Cell Painting features and was under-weighted (only 2 neighbors at 3µM, e17, mean sim 0.82).

Calibration failure: 0.71→0.74 remained overconfident based on same-well driven atlas evidence without replicate; PI critique was correct that e7/e15 were not independent.

Literature check: PP-2 mechanism as c-Src inhibitor is well documented via c-Src kinase studies (e.g., rapid c-Src activation contexts PMID:15674841; c-Src in barrier/morphology regulation PMID:10956618). Related epithelial morphology work illustrates actin/projection remodeling (PMID:8971683). ChEMBL cur

reflection.text:
Verdict: incorrect. Truth: Epithelial, Agent call: Protein synthesis (p=0.71 then 0.74). Unblinded compound PP-2 (CID 4878) had no curated ChEMBL mechanisms (e20, e21) so we were atlas-dependent.

What evidence got right:
* We correctly rejected primary microtubule destabilizer/Eg5 despite microscopist suggestion of those candidates (e6) and extreme high-dose morphology (e3: nuc_form_factor z=-33.7, act_glcm_contrast +28.0, nuc_solidity -26.0). The dose_response of tub_mean rho=+1.00 p=0 (e13) - tubulin intensity increasing, not loss - is inconsistent with destabilizer, which we used in e12/e18 rationale.
* We correctly noted the mitotic-like signal was late/weak: frac_mitotic_like rho=+0.80 p=0.2 (e9) over only 4 wells/4 doses with low power, and cell_count rho=-0.80 p=0.2 (e8) and nuc_dna_integrated rho=-0.80 p=0.2 (e14) were not significant. This supported that the high-dose well w_13e24cb3fd was not a clean antimitotic arrest.
* We captured monotonic morphology: nuc_area rho=-1.00 p=0 (e10) and act_glcm_contrast rho=+1.00 p=0 (e11) with progressive nuc_form_factor changes from w_21c0985e45 (0.1 uM, nuc_dna_mean -5.7, e4) to w_83f5e5592a (1 uM, -8.8, e2) to w_12aa18d253 (3 uM, -14.5, +5.0, e5) to w_13e24cb3fd (30 uM, -33.7, e3). That dose spread was discriminating as intended in step 1.

What misled and why:
* Over-weighting atlas similarity. e7: Protein synthesis 8/10, Microtubule destabilizer 2/10 using the two-well set. e15: 8/10 Protein synthesis including extreme 30 uM well alone. We treated these as independent confirmations, but as the review critique noted, e7 and e15 both relied on the same single unreplicated high-dose rep-1 well w_13e24cb3fd. Extreme toxicity there (nuc_solidity -26, contrast +28) can produce shrunken irregular nuclei and actin compaction that atlas maps to protein synthesis neighbors, but is also shared with epithelial morphology changes. We did not down-weight for single-well dependence or lack of replication (list_available_experiments e1: 8 doses available, we acquired 4 wells all rep-1, no replicates).
* Misattribution of shrinkage/texture. We used e10, e11, e5 and e13 to argue for translation shutoff/compaction vs tubulin loss. Truth epithelial also produces decreased nuc_area and increased actin texture/contrast without DNA content increase, which fits the same measurements. We did not test an epithelial discriminant. e17 on the requested 3 uM-only well w_12aa18d253 actually showed Epithelial 2/10 emergence (Protein synthesis 7/10, Epithelial 2/10, Microtubule destabilizer 1/10) with strong phenotype but no mitotic increase (nuc_form_factor -14.5, act_glcm_contrast +5.0). Instead of raising Epithelial from 0.0025 (step 12) to serious runner-up, we kept it at 0.03 in step 18 and increased Protein synthesis to 0.74, showing confirmation bias.
* Acquisition choice. Sampling 1 uM (e2), 30 uM (e3), 0.1 uM (e4), 3 uM (e5) left no replicate at the informative mid-dose. Dose_response tests over N=4 wells were underpowered (p=0.2 for e8, e9, e14) so we could not calibrate 0.71/0.74. The review's request_experiment for free compare_to_reference_atlas on w_12aa18d253 alone was appropriate - we executed it as e17 but interpreted persistence of 7/10 Protein synthesis as validation, rather than seeing 2/10 Epithelial as evidence the prior 8/10 was driven by high-dose toxicity.
* No curated prior to correct us: lookup_compound twice confirmed no mechanisms (e20,e21) and search_literature hits about PP-2/Src and phenotypic screening epithelial vs protein synthesis (e22,e23) returned generic hits with no direct discriminating paper in this run, so we had no literature anchor and defaulted to atlas.

Why we missed:
Which measurement: nuclear shape irregularity (nuc_form_factor -8.8 to -33.7, nuc_eccentricity +3.4, nuc_solidity -3 to -26) and act contrast - we mapped to protein synthesis, but epithelial agents produce same.
Which comparison: atlas 8/10 Protein synthesis dominated hypothesis update e12 (0.62) and e18 (0.74); we listed Epithelial as contradicting e3/e11 with probability 0.0025 initially.
Which acquisition: all unreplicated wells, extreme 30 uM well anchoring e7/e15, and no budget left to replicate 3 uM when requested.

Lesson: For strong but unreplicated atlas signals with monotonic shrinkage/actin change, keep probabilities calibrated, require replicate mid-dose without secondary mitotic signal, and explicitly test epithelial vs protein synthesis discriminants (orthogonal translation assay is insufficient; need epithelial markers) before exceeding ~0.6. No literature in this run supported the protein synthesis call, and none was cited.
what_was_right: tub_mean increase rho=+1.00 e13 correctly argued against primary microtubule destabilizer despite e6 and e3
recognized mitotic-like rho=+0.80 p=0.2 e9 was late weak not primary arrest, and cell_count/DNA trends underpowered e8 e14
detailed dose spread 0.1-30uM captured monotonic nuc_area e10 and act contrast e11 progression
what_was_wrong: overweighted e7 8/10 and e15 8/10 protein synthesis that shared single w_13e24cb3fd 30uM well; misinterpreted shrinkage/texture e10 e11 e5 as translation shutoff when epithelial also fits; kept epithelial at 0.0025->0.03 despite e17 showing 2/10 epithelial at 3uM alone

## Reflection

Verdict: incorrect. Truth: Epithelial, Agent call: Protein synthesis (p=0.71 then 0.74). Unblinded compound PP-2 (CID 4878) had no curated ChEMBL mechanisms (e20, e21) so we were atlas-dependent.

We treated these as independent confirmations, but as the review critique noted, e7 and e15 both relied on the same single unreplicated high-dose rep-1 well w_13e24cb3fd. Extreme toxicity there (nuc_solidity -26, contrast +28) can produce shrunken irregular nuclei and actin compaction that atlas maps to protein synthesis neighbors, but is also shared with epithelial morphology changes. We did not down-weight for single-well dependence or lack of replication (list_available_experiments e1: 8 doses available, we acquired 4 wells all rep-1, no replicates).
* Misattribution of shrinkage/texture. We used e10, e11, e5 and e13 to argue for translation shutoff/compaction vs tubulin loss. Truth epithelial also produces decreased nuc_area and increased actin texture/contrast without DNA content increase, which fits the same measurements. We did not test an epithelial discriminant. e17 on the requested 3 uM-only well w_12aa18d253 actually showed Epithelial 2/10 emergence (Protein synthesis 7/10, Epithelial 2/10, Microtubule destabilizer 1/10) with strong phenotype but no mitotic increase (nuc_form_factor -14.5, act_glcm_contrast +5.0). Instead of raising Epithelial from 0.0025 (step 12) to serious runner-up, we kept it at 0.03 in step 18 and increased Protein synthesis to 0.74, showing confirmation bias.
* Acquisition choice. Sampling 1 uM (e2), 30 uM (e3), 0.1 uM (e4), 3 uM (e5) left no replicate at the informative mid-dose. Dose_response tests over N=4 wells were underpowered (p=0.2 for e8, e9, e14) so we could not calibrate 0.71/0.74. The review's request_experiment for free compare_to_reference_atlas on w_12aa18d253 alone was appropriate - we executed it as e17 but interpreted persistence of 7/10 Protein synthesis as validation, rather than seeing 2/10 Epithelial as evidence the prior 8/10 was driven by high-dose toxicity.
* No curated prior to correct us: lookup_compound twice confirmed no mechanisms (e20,e21) and search_literature hits about PP-2/Src and phenotypic screening epithelial vs protein synthesis (e22,e23) returned generic hits with no direct discriminating paper in this run, so we had no literature anchor and defaulted to atlas.

Why we missed:
Which measurement: nuclear shape irregularity (nuc_form_factor -8.8 to -33.7, nuc_eccentricity +3.4, nuc_solidity -3 to -26) and act contrast - we mapped to protein synthesis, but epithelial agents produce same.
Which comparison: atlas 8/10 Protein synthesis dominated hypothesis update e12 (0.62) and e18 (0.74); we listed Epithelial as contradicting e3/e11 with probability 0.0025 initially.
Which acquisition: all unreplicated wells, extreme 30 uM well anchoring e7/e15, and no budget left to replicate 3 uM when requested.

Lesson: For strong but unreplicated atlas signals with monotonic shrinkage/actin change, keep probabilities calibrated, require replicate mid-dose without secondary mitotic signal, and explicitly test epithelial vs protein synthesis discriminants (orthogonal translation assay is insufficient; need epithelial markers) before exceeding ~0.6. No literature in this run supported the protein synthesis call, and none was cited.

What was right:
- tub_mean increase rho=+1.00 e13 correctly argued against primary microtubule destabilizer despite e6 and e3
- recognized mitotic-like rho=+0.80 p=0.2 e9 was late weak not primary arrest, and cell_count/DNA trends underpowered e8 e14
- detailed dose spread 0.1-30uM captured monotonic nuc_area e10 and act contrast e11 progression

What was wrong or missed:
- overweighted e7 8/10 and e15 8/10 protein synthesis that shared single w_13e24cb3fd 30uM well; misinterpreted shrinkage/texture e10 e11 e5 as translation shutoff when epithelial also fits; kept epithelial at 0.0025->0.03 despite e17 showing 2/10 epithelial at 3uM alone

Proposed next experiment: Replicate w_12aa18d253 (3uM) n=3 plus 1uM and assay epithelial discriminants (E-cadherin/B-catenin IF, colony morphology) alongside OPP-puromycin/phospho-eIF2a and pHH3 to separate translation inhibition from epithelial phenotype, with grayscale tubulin polymer quantification; avoid single 30uM anchor
